questions.question: How should the 5 forks be "started" on this machine?

options.label: --open-app: surface Claude.app at cwd, you pick each from /resume
options.description: Runs `open -a Claude.app ~/dev/ai-harness`. The forks are already in the app's local /resume picker for that cwd — you pick the 5 manually (5 clicks). Cleanest, no terminals spawn.

options.label: --open-terminal: spawn 5 Terminal.app windows running `claude -r <uuid>`
options.description: Each becomes an interactive CLI session immediately, but in Terminal rather than the desktop app. 5 new windows; you can close them later.

options.label: Both: --open-app AND --open-terminal
options.description: Surfaces the desktop app AND spawns 5 terminals. Probably overkill.

options.label: Send each a wake prompt headlessly first, THEN --open-app
options.description: Run `claude -r <uuid> -p "continue where you left off; await my next instruction"` for each in the background to advance the transcript, then open the app. Each will show fresh content when you pick it from /resume. (Each headless call is one billable turn.)
